description: Exact (string-math, no floating point) conversion between human token amounts and on-chain base units: wei / gwei / ether, lamports / SOL, sats / BTC, USDC/USDT (6 decimals) or any token with a decimals value. Returns the converted amount, the integer base units (decimal and hex) and every unit of the family. Accepts decimals, scientific notation and 0x-hex raw amounts. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: GET https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/token-units

decimals.description: Token decimals, needed for unit "token" (and for raw <-> token)

from.description: Unit of amount (raw = integer base units)

name: token_units
title: Token Units
